artists.biography: Jesus Jones are a British alternative dance band. The Wiltshire-based group, formed in late 1988, recorded and performed in the late 1980s, throughout the 1990s, and into the 2000s. They are best remembered for their track, "Right Here, Right Now", an international hit and subsequently globally appropriated for promotional and advertising campaigns. They are also well-remembered for the songs "Real Real Real" and "International Bright Young Thing."

perplexity.description:
Already, released in August 1997, is the fourth studio album by British band Jesus Jones, issued originally on Food Records/EMI and later reissued by Demon Records. Musically, the album marks a notable shift toward a more pop-oriented sound, echoing elements of their earlier successful album Doubt while maintaining their electronic rock foundation. The production blends electronic textures with accessible melodies, featuring singles like "The Next Big Thing" and "Chemical #1" that highlight this stylistic direction.

In the context of Jesus Jones' discography, Already followed the critically acclaimed but less commercially successful Perverse (1993), which was notable for its fully digital recording approach. While Already did not achieve significant commercial success—peaking at only No. 161 on the UK Albums Chart—it represented the band's final release with EMI before moving toward a more acoustic and low-key style on their subsequent album London. The album received modest radio play, particularly for "The Next Big Thing," but overall it marked a period of transition and reduced mainstream visibility for the band.
